page_title: AUG 2-1 FRE | Augsburg v Freiburg 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Augsburg have a corner.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Iago (Augsburg) for a tough tackle.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
88' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
84' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) replaces Ruben Vargas.
81' 2 - 1 Arne Engels (Augsburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
79' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Phillip Tietz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
79' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Bastian Dankert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
76' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Merlin Rohl and he is replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) coming on for Vincenzo Grifo.
76' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
75' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastian Dankert no option but to blow his whistle.
72' 1 - 1 Goal! Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
72' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Iago (Augsburg) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Noah Atubolu to make a comfortable save.
69' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roland Sallai (Freiburg) replacing Michael Gregoritsch.
66' A substitution has been made. Christian Gunter is replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
62' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
58' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
56' Here is a change. Elvis Rexhbecaj is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Arne Maier (Augsburg).
56' Today's match ends for Fredrik Jensen who will be replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
55' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
53' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) makes a strong challenge and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
50' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
48' Dangerous play by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg). Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Referee Bastian Dankert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
45+4' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) will deliver the corner kick.
45+1' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
45' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
44' A superb shot by Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
43' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

42' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Augsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away.
37' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lukas Kubler departs the field of play to be replaced by Matthias Ginter (Freiburg).
36' Looks like Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
35' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
32' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul after Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) hacks down one of his opponents.
27' Flag up against Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
23' Today's referee Bastian Dankert rightly decides to book Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) for his harsh tackle.
22' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
22' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Augsburg.
19' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Finn Dahmen no chance!
19' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
18' Referee Bastian Dankert sees the trip by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Penalty awarded! Freiburg will take a penalty kick.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
14' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
12' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
10' Flag goes up against Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Iago (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.

4' OFF THE POST! Iago (Augsburg) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
2' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' The first half has started.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will officiate today.
